consequence.statement: Installing 0.16.0 can fail with 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook'.
consequence.remediation: Use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on your installation path; the guide says 0.16.1 should fix this.

original.statement: The 0.16.0 troubleshooting guide says installing 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook", and that 0.16.1 should be used instead because it fixes this.

decision.reason: [ev-0eb3d16492e3] is a Troubleshooting entry in the 0.16 promotion guide. It quotes the error 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook' and says to use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on the installation path. An error on the installation path whose only workaround is a different release means installing or upgrading to 0.16.0 can fail, which fits upgrade-blocked with 0.16.1 as the remediation. Confidence is low because the text never says 'fails' outright or which installations are hit. The rendered diffs (e.g. [ev-7a082965d61c]) show spec.conversion removed from the chart's CRDs in 0.16.0, but no upstream text ties that removal to the error, so they are context only.
